name: Unidentified Hutt trawler
description: A trawler was utilized by the Hutt Clan during the High Republic Era. Between around 397 BBY and 387 BBY, the trawler towed a ship containing members of the Evereni Ro family—the cousins Marda and Yana, as well as the two's mothers—to the Hutt Space moon Nar Shaddaa where the Hutts attempted to enslave them. The Path of the Open Hand cult stepped in to save the Ros and the cousins ultimately became members of the group.
